description.text: Certificate Granting Students are required to complete the curriculum, fullfill the designated number of credits, complete the doctorate thesis and defend of it. Successful graduates will receive a graduation certificate along with the degree.

duration.text: The Solid Mechanics at Harbin Engineering University is a 3 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 6250 USD/per year ￥ 45000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.Photocopy of valid passport With name, passport number & expiration date, and photo included 2.Passport photo A recent passport-sized photo of the applicant 3.Postgraduate school transcript 4.Master's degree diploma Graduation certificate in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. 5.Letter of recommendation From professor or associate professor or equivalents

requirements.text: 1.Foreign citizens 2.In good health 3.Master Degree in related courses 4.language proficiency: TOFEL 550 or more, or IELTS 6.0 or more, or provide other Engslish proficiency certificate (the student, who is from English countries or his/her mother language is English, needn’t submit the English proficiency certificate).
